problem_statement: The DHCPv6 PD client mishandles delegated-prefix lease renewal and rebind. When a server Reply returns the delegated prefix with a zero valid lifetime (optionally carrying a NoPrefixAvail status), the client keeps the lease instead of discarding it and restarting discovery, so it never re-solicits. Separately, the client's T1/T2 computation is wrong: when the server gives only one of T1 or T2 (leaving the other zero), the client fills the missing value without keeping T1 <= T2, and short T1 values are raised to a 5-minute floor instead of a 1-minute floor, producing renewal/rebind times that do not match the server's intent. The client must discard leases with zero valid lifetime regardless of status and re-solicit, and must honor a server-provided T1 or T2 while choosing the other so that T1 does not exceed T2.
